notes.title: Free Content Update! 2 Horde maps and 2 Score Attack OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29079075/0d002222a0467f59f01863ed59fe3cac5a371a57.jpg

Attention adventurers, the latest Strange Brigade update is rolling out RIGHT NOW and includes three FREE maps for all players! This update also includes various bug fixes, accessibility updates and more, so keep those peepers peeled...

Patch Notes
New free Horde map “Tunnels”.
New free Score Attack Map “The Towering Temple II”.
New free Score Attack Map “Cursed Village II”.
Improved subtitle options including the ability to change scale and visibility.
Various bug fixes and stability improvements.

*Don't forget the Season Pass content is coming out tomorrow!
